Publication commands were not executed.

The documents clearly distinguish unpublished candidates, later authorization and durable recovery. Prerequisites separate the tkt executable from plugin skills, require Node 22 and Rust 1.85, install the Claude dependency first and avoid duplicate deployment. Windows Known Folder discovery, Kiro home isolation, Antigravity updater/shadow limitations and unavailable Windows/Linux network isolation agree with the linked native reports. Claims about model activation and authenticated hooks are bounded. Asset arithmetic is consistent: five plugin assets plus sixteen dist/crate assets and one stage seal gives twenty-two tkt release assets.

No banned vocabulary, filler, unsupported enthusiasm, redundant conclusion or unclear instruction warrants a rewrite. This is a prose/static accuracy review, not a replacement for the pinned carrier verification or future publication preflight.
